scripts.names:refresh: rolldown tools/refresh-names-main.ts -d dist-tools --platform node -f esm && node dist-tools/refresh-names-main.js
scripts.web:local: cd apps/web && vite build --mode localhost --outDir dist-local && vite preview --outDir dist-local --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.test:e2e: npm run web:build && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/web
scripts.test:desktop: npm run desktop:build && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && node tools/pack.mjs filtergen
scripts.desktop:setup: node node_modules/electron/install.js && cd node_modules/koffi && node ./cnoke.cjs -P . -D src/koffi --prebuild --release
scripts.checker:pack: npm run checker:build && node tools/pack.mjs checker
scripts.test:checker: npm run checker:build && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/checker
